note: Every file an implementation of the 0.1.0-draft.1 toolchain contracts pins, by repository path. A pin copies each tree whole and each file as is. `references` are documents the pages link to that are not pinned, with the reason; an implementation must not depend on more of them than the reason allows. A test requires every listed path to exist, every toolchain page and schema to be listed, and every repository file a pinned page links to to be pinned or referenced.

references.reason: A design draft that defines the version-2 extension release descriptor by example. A binding check relies only on the descriptor members listed in the toolset recipe page's table of what a binding check reads; the descriptor's own member table or schema belongs to the extension contract changes.

A design draft that defines the capability claim set. A binding check relies only on the claim set members listed in the toolset recipe page's table of what a binding check reads; the claim set's own member table or schema belongs to the extension contract changes.
The IR has its own version authority. The toolchain contracts read only an IR document's formatVersion, in the readiness workflow's expected files.
The IR v4 schema, which the readiness workflow's expected IR follows. It is pinned with the IR contract, not with these contracts.
